questions.question: Any missing data may be suitably assumed 1(a) Differentiate between: (i) Constraint surface and composite constraint surface. (ii) Linear and non-linear programming problems. $(04) (b) A$ two bar truss is to be designed to carry a load of $2W$ as shown in Fig.1. Both bars have a tubular section with mean diameter d and wall thickness t. The material of the bars has Young’s modulus $E$, and yield stress \sigma _{y}. The design problem involves the determination of the values of d and t so that the weight of the truss is a minimum, and neither yielding nor buckling occurs in any of the bars. Formulate the problem as a nonlinear programming problem. (06) 2(a) The profit per acre of a firm is given by $20x$_{1} $+ 26x$_{2} $+4x$_{1} x_{2} $- 4x$_{1}$^{2} -3x$_{2}$^{2}$ where x_{1} and x_{2} denote respectively the labour cost and the fertilizer cost. Find the values of x_{1} and x_{2} to maximize the profit. $(04) (b)$ Find the solution for the following linear problem by using Lagrange multipliers: Minimize $f = 2x$_{1} $- 3x$_{2}, subject to x_{1} $+ x$_{2} $\le 1; -2x$_{1} $+ x$_{2} $\ge 2; x$_{1}, $x$_{2} $\ge$ 0. (06) 3(a) Briefly explain the principle of cubic interpolation method for one dimensional optimization technique. $(04) (b)$ Solve the following LP problem by simplex method. Minimize $f = -3x$_{1} $- 2x$_{2}, subject to x_{1} $- x$_{2} $\le 1; 3x$_{1} $- 2x$_{2} $\le 6; x$_{1}, $x$_{2} $\ge$ 0. (06) 4(a) Explain the steepest descent method of unconstrained minimization technique. $(04) (b)$ For the function $f(x) = 7x^{2} - 20x + 22$, using Golden section method, find the minimum within an accuracy of 0.01. Carry out atleast four iterations. (06) 5(a) Discuss interior penalty function method with respect to constrained optimization technique. $(04) (b)$ Minimize $f(X) = x$_{1} $- x$_{2}$+ 2x$_{1}$^{2} + 2x$_{1} x_{2} $+ x$_{2}$^{2}$ starting from the point $X$_{1} $= \{0, 0\}^{T}$.
